description: Greg is running to represent the 47th Assembly District because he believes California deserves better. As a third-generation Californian, he believes that our state should be the land of economic opportunity and social mobility. Greg’s core beliefs, namely the importance of hard work, independence, and perseverance, reflect the California mindset. Greg is confident he can help our region rise to the level of innovation California is known for.
